explanations.text:
●  a change wants to reach its twin                 ([the promise](PROMOTION))
  │     A file changed on one side and its twin still
  │     shows the old text. The copy runs either way, so
  │     the public version always matches the showcase.
  │
  ●  you find the twin of the changed file            ([the pairs](The pairs))
  │     One table row per pair: the showcase on the left,
  │     its public twin on the right.
  │     A file that is not in the table has no twin and
  │     stays where it is.
  │
  ●  you carry the change over                            ([the run](The run))
        Five steps, in order: save the old copy, edit and
        sync the map exactly once against the saved copy,
        copy the new version over the twin, run the rules
        of CLAUDE.md, and look at the result.
        The saved copy exists for one reason: the sync
        must see the exact last version the map knew.
